answer: Down in the spring house the cheesemaker pots the cream into earthen pots with lids of cloth, tying the cloth lids down with twine. Press herb milk carrier curd charter covers the potting: a charter herb milk carriers hold after dairy yard inspections. The falcon leads the potting; the yarrow ends the pot; the ripple guards the cream. A counterfeiter faces 89 false pots and 89 false pottings.
